scene_timeline.visual_description: Ahmad Alzahabi introduces the concept of elevating plain rice in his kitchen.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Sometimes plain rice gets boring, try this next time. Here's how to take it up a notch.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Slicing and sautéing onions and jalapeños in a pan with oil and curry powder.
scene_timeline.audio_description: In some dancing oil, go in with an onion and a jalapeño and a tiny bit of curry powder.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Adding washed basmati rice to the pan and stirring to toast it.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Now go in with a bunch of washed basmati rice and toast.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Pouring lite coconut milk into the rice mixture, followed by salt and more curry powder.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Now go in with a bunch of lite coconut milk. Now go in with a bunch of salt and more curry powder.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Ahmad explains the simmering process while placing a lid on the steaming pot.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Now bring to a boil, cover, drop to a simmer and cook for about 12 minutes.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Adding chopped cilantro and lime juice to the cooked rice and fluffing it.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Now add some cilantro, a bunch of lime juice, and now we have the final product.

parsed_output.overall_summary: Ahmad Alzahabi, known as @thegoldenbalance, demonstrates a quick and flavorful way to upgrade plain white rice. The recipe involves sautéing onions and jalapeños with curry powder before toasting basmati rice in the same pan. The rice is then cooked in lite coconut milk and finished with fresh cilantro and lime juice. The result is a fragrant, creamy, and spicy coconut curry rice that serves as a versatile side dish.

people.description: Ahmad Alzahabi, a male food creator wearing a black Alphalete t-shirt.

takeaways.statement: Toasting rice with aromatics and spices before boiling adds significant depth of flavor.
Replacing water with coconut milk creates a creamier, more decadent rice texture.
Finishing rice with fresh acid (lime) and herbs (cilantro) brightens the heavy flavors of coconut and curry.

items.name: Coconut Curry Rice
items.details: 1 cup washed basmati rice, 2 cups lite coconut milk, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp curry powder, 1/2 onion (sliced), 1 jalapeño (sliced), fresh cilantro, lime juice.

items.name: Cooking Instructions
items.details: Sauté onion and jalapeño in oil with curry powder. Add rice and toast. Add coconut milk, salt, and more curry powder. Bring to boil, cover, and simmer for 12 minutes. Finish with cilantro and lime.
